name: Oakridge Advisory
tagline: Begin a conversation with Oakridge Advisory.

copy.headline: Tell us about your situation. We will advise you plainly.
copy.lead: Share a few details and you will receive our initial assessment at once. A partner at {name} reads every enquiry personally.
points: Every enquiry is read by a partner.
If we are not the right fit, we will tell you so.
There is no obligation and no fee to enquire.
copy.goalPlaceholder: e.g. Our team built a customer portal using AI tooling. It is in use today, and we would like it independently assessed and made dependable.
copy.finePrint: We ask that you do not include passwords, keys or customer data in your enquiry.
